casuallab.title: HTE recovery gate
casuallab.question: Can a treatment-effect model identify who benefits most?
casuallab.method: Compare held-out predictions with known effects and a constant-effect oracle.
casuallab.finding: The learner loses to the oracle (0.0417 vs 0.0247 RMSE) and fails the gate.
casuallab.note: Semi-synthetic validation—not a live-market effect estimate.
casuallab.chart_caption: Lower RMSE is better; the learner must beat the oracle.

macroeconomics.title: Vintage leakage audit
macroeconomics.question: Did the backtest use future data?

headline.label: future-eligibility cells in a naive backtest

macroeconomics.method: Rebuild 7,985 inputs under three data-vintage rules and audit availability.
macroeconomics.finding: Valid modes leak 0 cells; naive revised leaks 863 and changes 2 of 3 model rankings.
macroeconomics.note: Naive revised is a leakage benchmark, not a valid backtest.
macroeconomics.chart_caption: Valid backtests use no inputs unavailable at the forecast date.

realestate.title: Mortgage lock-in profile
realestate.question: How does the mortgage-rate gap relate to loan exits?

headline.label: hazard ratio per +1 pp rate gap

realestate.method: Compare monthly exits by rate gap, then fit an adjusted discrete-time logit.
realestate.finding: Each +1 pp gap is associated with a 0.817 exit-hazard ratio.
realestate.note: Exits include refinancing, sale payoff, and maturity; the association is not causal.
realestate.chart_caption: Points show raw exit rates; 0.817 is the adjusted estimate.

microstructure.title: Exploratory strategy simulation
microstructure.question: Did the predictive edge survive fees and drawdown?
microstructure.method: Compare 144 deterministic market-order scenarios across two symbols, two pseudo-heldout phases, four horizons, and a 3×3 latency grid under a frozen 4 bp taker fee.
microstructure.finding: 110 scenarios are gross-positive, but none remain positive after the frozen fee; median net edge is −3.855 bp per turnover.
microstructure.note: Research reference only: one nonconfirmatory capture, simulated execution, no profitability or capacity claim.
microstructure.chart_caption: Metric-wise minimum, median, and maximum across 144 mutually exclusive counterfactual scenarios; values must not be summed.

tariff-incidence.title: Tariff incidence decomposition
tariff-incidence.question: Did exporters cut prices, or did U.S. importers absorb the tariff?
tariff-incidence.method: Estimate landed, customs, and quantity effects across three windows, with diagnostic checks.
tariff-incidence.finding: Customs values stay near +0.025 and within ±0.076; landed values track the tariff.
tariff-incidence.note: The duty enters landed values mechanically; quantity fails its date placebo.
tariff-incidence.chart_caption: Lines show three windows; references mark the tariff change or customs bound.
